contradictions: Payout figure differs by platform at the same time (Oct 2026): X bio $1,300,000; TikTok bio $1,800,000+; YouTube $2,000,000+; jjwebinar.com $1,500,000+; mentorship page 'built from $1,300,000'; PropFirmEV '$1.3M'.

Time-to-figure: YouTube about says 16 months of experience at $1.5M; Words of Rizdom promo says $1.8M+ in 18 months; youtubesummary says $1.2M in 12-13 months. These are mutually consistent only if roughly $300k was added per 2-3 months in mid-2026.
Income positioning: YouTube channel says 'scale to $30K+/mo' in one snippet and 'scale to $10K+/mo' in another (different crawl dates).

Firms: jjwebinar lists E8, Topstep, Tradeify; the per-firm breakdown lists Topstep, E8, Funded Engineer, MyFundedFutures; the linktr.ee list names 17 firms including Apex, Bulenox, FundedNext, Alpha; Lucid appears only via a student testimonial; Bulwark was not found in any snippet.

Pricing: official mentorship price is not published; resale sites quote fake 'original' prices of $6,000-$6,500 and sale prices $249.99-$497; Whop shows a $299.99 pre-recorded workshop; AllPros does not display a price.
Trade frequency: ~10 trades/day (sozai summary) vs '30 Times/Day' (Chart Fanatics title).
Reviews: Whop 4.9/5 (46 reviews) and AllPros 4.6/5 (5 reviews) vs faketrades.in 1.0/5 (strategy, not mentorship).
Verification: all 'verified payouts' wording is JJ's; the 365-day backtester and the prop-firm-challenge video both state his claims are not independently verified.
